doc.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025

title: Rowe praises DiMartino, with Milt Hinton, Joe Wilder and Clark Terry
summary: Rowe says people light up at his name, as with Hinton, Wilder and Terry, and thanks him.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: You know there’s a small number of people I’ve met over the years, including people like Milt Hinton —
Oh I played with him many times.
I wish I’d met him. Now that’s the guy I wish I’d met.
Yeah. He was marvelous. And people — these people I’m describing, every time their name comes up people always have a, “Ohhh, Joe Wilder” or “Ohhh, Clark Terry.”

So I’m including you in that group, Vince, because I’ve talked to three or four people before this interview and they all went, “Ohhh, Vince man, that cat —” so you have led a remarkable career and spread a lot of positive energy over the years to a lot of people. So I want to thank you for that.
